name: combat2d
description: Where damage comes from in 2D: what hurts by touching (ContactDamage) and what flies and hits (Projectile, with an area of effect, homing, piercing and a slowing effect). The damage itself is an ordinary Damage request, applied by the health module to whatever has Health: this module knows nothing about monsters, players or towers, only about colliders and layers.

components.name: ContactDamage
components.description: The entity hurts what it touches: every entity that has a Health and a Collider on one of the layers (a set of names or bits of the game's layer list, all by default) and overlaps this entity's Collider gets a Damage of amount. It needs a Collider and a Position. With cooldown the entity hurts at most once every that many ticks (wait is what is left); without it, it hurts at each tick it touches. A monster that bites, a spike, fire, a body that kills the player that runs into it.

components.name: Projectile
components.description: The entity flies and hurts the first entity with a Health whose Collider (on one of the layers, all by default) it overlaps: damage points, and it is destroyed by the hit. It needs a Collider and moves by its own Velocity (a Lifetime lets it end by itself). With splash_radius above 0 everything with a Health within that many units of the hit is hurt as well (an explosion). With pierce above 0 it goes through that many targets before it is destroyed (it never hits the same one twice in a row). With homing above 0 (0 to 1, the share of the turn made each tick) it steers towards the nearest entity it could hit, keeping its speed. With on_hit_speed_factor under 1 the entities it hurts are slowed to that share of their speed for on_hit_speed_ticks ticks (transform2d.SpeedScale).

systems.name: steer
systems.description: Turns every homing Projectile towards the nearest entity it could hit.

systems.name: shots
systems.description: Lets every Projectile hit the entity it overlaps (and those around it, with a splash): they get a Damage, and a slow if the projectile has one; the projectile is destroyed unless it pierces.

systems.name: touch
systems.description: Gives a Damage to every entity with a Health that a ContactDamage entity overlaps.
